name: sweep
summary: Reports stale tickets and tickets owned by a dead lane through wake-gate, and puts a dead lane's tickets back in the queue; unknown liveness never takes a ticket away.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (live-owners.txt, holds/ and events.jsonl live in $HUBKIT_HOME/state)
env.LEDGER_PATH: optional: read this ledger file instead of $HUBKIT_HOME/state/ledger.jsonl
env.SWEEP_LIVE_OWNERS: optional: path of the live-owner list instead of $HUBKIT_HOME/state/live-owners.txt

needs: the ledger pattern installed next to it
a script of yours that writes the live-owner list (format in README)
